host_baseline.basis: measured once with the pinned host and a role's structured-output tool (athena.toml [agents]); not measured per invocation

input.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

output.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_read.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_write.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cost.basis: Claude Code total_cost_usd, at list price

commands_run: cargo fmt --all && cargo test --locked -p athena-context the_reader_brief 2>&1
cargo test --locked -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p xtask --test policy 2>&1
cargo test --locked -p athena-context 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test mirrors --test budgets 2>&1

policy_denials.detail: cargo fmt --all && cargo test --locked -p athena-context the_reader_brief 2>&1 | tail -15; cargo test --locked -p athena-core criterion 2>&1 | tail -20; cargo test --locked -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus 2>&1 | tail -8
cargo test --locked -p athena-core criteri 2>&1 | grep -E "^test |test result|error|FAILED"; cargo test --locked -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|error"
cargo fmt --all --check && echo FMT_OK; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1; cargo test --locked -p athena-context -p athena-core -p athena-cli --lib --tests 2>&1
